answer.explanation: The MCP numerator is 649 classified Dragapult entries, against all 3,973 imported entries, so the observed classified share is 16.34%. Unclassified entrants remain in the denominator. This is not an estimate of the true Dragapult share among entrants whose deck information is missing; unmapped source labels can also fragment parent archetypes.
